getallheaders
=============

PHP `getallheaders()` polyfill. Compatible with PHP >= 5.3.

This is a simple polyfill for [`getallheaders()`](http://example.invalid/manual/en/function.getallheaders.php).

## Install

```
composer require ralouphie/getallheaders
```
